data.question: What do the notes say about Lena's allergy and Biscuit's medicine?

passages.text: That is the end of this note.

past_sources.text: Biscuit needs his antibiotic every twelve hours, according to the vet.

answer: The notes say Lena has a peanut allergy, and Biscuit needs an antibiotic every 12 hours, according to the vet. [[m2]] [[m1]]
